ExpiredTokenNotUsed.summary: school-pulse stores expires_at, then sync ignores it and sends the access token.
ExpiredTokenNotUsed.why: readToken returns access_token and never branches on expires_at or refresh_token. runSync passes that string straight to the Classroom and OneNote fetchers. The auth command is a separate path, so an expired file does not become re-auth-needed.
ExpiredTokenNotUsed.codePath: Pinned school-pulse 3b76b08. Exchange writes expires_at in src/auth/oauth.ts:108-115. readToken is src/main.ts:150-157. runSync uses the string at src/main.ts:124-132.
ExpiredTokenNotUsed.repro: Local copy of school-pulse at 3b76b08. npm test ran the new test in the repo's node:test runner. It expected readToken to return null for an expires_at in 2020. The actual value was synthetic-access-token. The other 57 tests in that run passed. No draft PR was opened on BoydVC/school-pulse.

actions.Age: expires_at is stored and never read again
